title: VPC change decision triage playbook and test cases
body:
Purpose
Quick reference playbook for approving, triaging, and validating VPC/network changes for Private/On‑Prem customers. Focus is on minimum audit evidence, deterministic smoke tests, and decision criteria for approvals vs. rollback. This is a working doc — notes to self, test snippets, and TODOs mixed in.

Goals
- Make approval decisions reproducible and auditable.
- Define a small suite of automated test cases that catch common customer regressions (routing, DNS, egress, auth).
- Standardize what evidence to attach to change approvals.
- Provide clear rollback triggers and post‑change validation windows.

Context / scope
- Applies to changes that touch customer VPC/Tenant connectivity: route table updates, firewall/security group edits, NAT/egress configuration, BGP peering edits, subnet reassignments, and control-plane agent upgrades that alter networking.
- Excludes purely application-level config changes (handled by app runbooks).

Quick decision matrix (operator cheat):
- Low risk (doced change + no routing rewrite + automated tests pass): Single approver (network operator) -> schedule window -> post‑change smoke -> close.
- Medium risk (route edits, new peering, BGP AS change): Two approver gate (operator + cust-eng) + synthetic tests + 30m validation window -> autopromote if green.
- High risk (mass subnet moves, control-plane networking change, customer-requested firewall default deny): Exec approval + SRE-oncall present during window + extended validation (1–4h) + fallback path in place.

Minimum evidence bundle to attach to approval request
- Change description (what, why, rollback plan).
- Terraform/CloudFormation diff or raw CLI commands used.
- Expected packet flow diagram (simple ASCII ok).
- Pre-change baseline: curl latency to internal health endpoints, kube API reachability, and traceroute to key customer endpoints.
- Post-change capture: tcpdump sample (10–30s), traceroute, and control-plane logs (agent startup/time).
- Signed attestation from operator with timestamp and runbook id.

Test cases (automated / manual) — prioritized, fast to run
1) Control-plane liveness (30s) — automated
- Verify control-plane agent heartbeats (agent_id + last_seen).
- Expected: last_seen < 30s.
- Failure: immediate rollback.

2) Tenant API reachability (60s) — automated
- curl -sSf https://{tenant_internal}/healthz -> 200
- Also check header X-Cluster-ID matches expected.
- Failure: escalate to cust-eng, roll back if degraded for >5m.

3) Egress/SNAT spot-check (60s) — automated
- hit an external echo endpoint to validate source IP and egress path.
- compare before/after public IP address list.
- Failure: temporary block may indicate NAT change; follow verification steps.

4) DNS resolution validation (45s) — automated
- dig for internal service CNAMEs and external resolvers.
- ensure resolver IPs are in expected set.
- Failure: could break service discovery; pause rollout.

5) Inter-subnet connectivity (2m) — manual/automated hybrid
- run traceroutes between representative pods/VMs across subnets.
- check ACLs/security-group counters.
- Failure: route table or ACL error; rollback.

6) BGP session sanity (2–5m) — for peering changes
- verify session established, prefix advertisement matches expected filters.
- inspect BGP RIB for unexpected routes.
- Failure: withdraw offending prefixes, fallback to alternate peering if configured.

Operational runbook (during change window)
- Pre-window: confirm approvers on Slack + runbook link + pager aware. Attach evidence bundle to approval.
- Start: take timestamp t0, take pre-change baselines (curl, traceroute, tcpdump).
- Apply change (automated apply preferred).
- Immediately run smoke tests 1–4. If any fail, execute rollback plan.
- If smoke green, monitor error-rate/latency dashboards for 30–60 minutes (tenant traffic + control‑plane).
- If anomalies appear after initial green, follow tiered escalation: oncall -> SRE lead -> product owner -> customer notify.

Rollback triggers (explicit)
- Control-plane agent not present in cluster after 2m.
- Tenant API 5xx rate > 1% (sustained for 3m).
- Loss of BGP session for >60s on critical peer.
- Key service error-rate spike coincident with change and not explained by known load event.

Sample audit log snippet to attach (operator should paste a compact extract):

{"timestamp":"2025-02-03T11:12:34Z","operator":"priya.r","action":"apply","change_id":"PD-VPC-238","diff":"+route 10.4.0.0/16 via 192.0.2.5"}

Notes: include only relevant lines (avoid full logs). Keep the record small and searchable.

Synthetic test harness ideas (automated)
- lightweight python harness that runs the 1–4 checks and produces a JSON result summary. Store summary in S3 with path naming: /evidence/{customer}/{change_id}/{t0}/summary.json
- include base64 small tcpdump snippets for forensic playback.

Test case false positives we see often
- Short-lived DNS TTL propagation causing transient dig failures. Mitigation: retry 3x with 5s backoff, require sustained failure.
- Load spikes unrelated to change (customer load tests). Mitigation: correlate with traffic tags, ask customer about scheduled jobs.
- BGP flap noise from intermediate provider. Mitigation: require >60s continuous outage to trigger rollback.

Audit/compliance notes
- Evidence retention: keep per-change artifacts for 90 days minimum; for enterprise customers store 1 year.
- Anonymize PII in tcpdump excerpts before attaching to shared storage.
- If customer requires keystore-based attestation, attach signature blob and KMS key id.

Example approval request template (paste in ticket):
- Title: [PD-VPC-238] Add route for analytics subnets -> peer A
- Description: short what/why and expected impact
- Rollback plan: commands to revert + contact oncall + estimated time to revert
- Evidence attached: pre-baseline.zip, post-trace.tcpdump, summary.json
- Approvers requested: operator, cust-eng, SRE lead

Open TODOs / decisions
- Decide a canonical store for evidence (S3 vs internal object store). Pref: S3 with restricted bucket per-customer.
- Hook synthetic harness into Console so change pages autoembed summary.
- Define smaller SLA buckets for sampling windows (15m vs 60m) per customer tier.
- Add a med-risk default approver list for partner-managed customers.

Notes to self (rough)
- Collect sample tcpdump extractor script from Luis.
- Mei to prototype the harness -> store to /evidence path.
- Add a sample SLO dashboard widget showing the last change delta for a tenant (errors, p50 latency).

Sign-off checklist for finalizing PRD
- [ ] Agree on decision matrix with SRE and CustEng
- [ ] Finalize evidence retention and encryption requirements
- [ ] Build prototype harness and demo in next demo week
- [ ] Draft customer-facing change checklist for Self-hosted onboarding docs

End — ping me in #pd-private if you want to walk through the harness examples or help stitch tests into CI.
